claims.claim: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Google's Gemini 4 Neon both recorded the maximum 450 points on the 2027 CSAT.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Google's Gemini 4 Neon both recorded the maximum 450 points on the 2027 College Scholastic Ability Test.
claims.source_title: GPT and Gemini Achieve Perfect Scores on South Korea's College Entrance Exam

claims.claim: NVIDIA released 14 open 3B and 8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints that decode up to 4.20x faster than autoregressive decoding.
claims.episode_span: NVIDIA released 14 open 3B and 8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints under the Nemotron-Labs-Sigma name. The models denoise text inside a learned 16-D embedding space, distill to few-step samplers, and decode up to 4.20x faster than autoregressive decoding.
claims.source_title: NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a Continuous Diffusion Language Model with 14 checkpoints at 3B/8B
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 open 3B and 8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints. Sigma denoises text in a learned 16-D embedding space, distills to few-step samplers, and decodes up to 4.20x faster than autoregressive decoding.

claims.claim: Qubrio compiles batches of stages in roughly five minutes and was evaluated on QASMBench workloads up to 78 qubits.
claims.episode_span: Evaluated across QASMBench workloads up to 78 qubits and compared against both heuristic compilers and simulated annealing with 10,000× larger evaluation budgets, Qubrio consistently delivered faster execution schedules and higher circuit fidelity while compiling batches of stages in roughly five minutes.
claims.source_title: University of California, QuEra, and Collaborators Introduce Multi-Agent LLM Compiler Qubrio for Neutral-Atom Processors
claims.supporting_quote: Evaluated across QASMBench workloads up to 78 qubits and compared against both heuristic compilers and simulated annealing with 10,000× larger evaluation budgets, Qubrio consistently delivered faster execution schedules and higher circuit fidelity while compiling batches of stages in roughly five minutes.

claims.claim: DeepSec maintains persistent state inside a .deepsec/ directory and resumes interrupted runs by skipping already-analyzed files.
claims.episode_span: It supports optional massive parallelism via Vercel Sandboxes for large repositories and resumes interrupted runs by skipping files already analyzed, allowing operators to pick an AI model with benchmark scores and pricing displayed during setup.
claims.source_title: GitHub - vercel-labs/deepsec: Deepsec is a security harness for finding vulnerabilities in your codebase powered by coding agents
claims.supporting_quote: If a run is interrupted or errors out partway through, just re-run the same command — deepsec picks up where it left off, skipping files it already analyzed and only investigating the rest.
